args.new_string: Status: Stage 4 schematic captured and original symbol/ERC/drift/legibility checks executed, 2026-10-08; see fresh results and the disclosed descriptive-metadata limitation below.

## Observed Stage 4 capture

Stage 4 actual draft, 2026-10-08: fresh draft_schematic generated all ten fitted BOM refdes in four groups, with 32 wire segments, three labels and seven intentional no-connects on A4. Actual verify_symbols reports 11 symbol definitions matching the installed libraries or exact engine power templates, with no divergences. Actual run_erc and check_drift are clean. check_legibility reports zero errors and one low-utilization advisory; the reported draft score is 91.38/100. All seven unique assigned footprints resolve OK in the current run. The prior refused attempt was rolled back; these are fresh generation/check results, not carried-over passes. No PCB implementation or physical qualification is claimed.

The read-back intent retains six functional nets: VBUS_RAW, +5V_PROTECTED, GND, CC1, CC2 and LED_A. The draft report identifies VBUS_RAW and +5V_PROTECTED as separate rails and synthesizes PWR_FLAG on VBUS_RAW/GND; power metadata adds no fitted consumer.

Rationale: distinguish current software evidence from historical documentation checks and all pending electrical/manufacturing qualification.

## Generated U1 metadata limitation

Current generated-file search shows the embedded Power_Management:TPS2065CDBV definition retains parent descriptive properties Value=TPS2051CDBV and Description beginning 0.5A. The actual fitted U1 instance Value=TPS2065CDBVR, canonical lib_id, verified five-pin map, footprint and BOM selection are correct and unchanged. Do not use the inherited description as device-rating evidence or substitute TPS2051C limits. Use the exact TPS2065CDBVR manufacturer evidence in this BOM; physical qualification remains pending. The current clean symbol report verifies pins and engine power templates, not the correctness of all descriptive metadata. Before reusing/exporting this embedded definition as a standalone part library, correct the capture engine's inherited-property handling through a supported workflow. No direct generated-sheet edit or electrical workaround was made.

Rationale: the reviewable prototype keeps its exact physical part identity while openly disclosing misleading inherited descriptive metadata.
